maker: Spirit AI (Wanjing Qianxun (Beijing) Technology Co., Ltd.)
name: Spirit AI Moz1
summary: A wheeled humanoid with two 7-DOF force-controlled arms, two-finger grippers and an omnidirectional base, sold with an SDK and teleoperation kit for embodied-AI data collection and indoor service tasks.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller or distributor found; Spirit AI's website and manuals name only Chinese contacts.

specs.label: Total DOF
specs.quote: Equipped with the world's highest power-density integrated force/torque-controlled joints, with 26 degrees of freedom

specs.label: DOF per arm
specs.quote: Fitted with high - performance force/torque - position hybrid controlled 7-Dof bionic arms

specs.label: Charging
specs.quote: 充电参数54.8V / 10A（恒流恒压）2充电形式手动连接（需人工操作）

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Intel D455 head camera, two D405 wrist cameras, MID-360S lidar
specs.quote: 1头部相机（Intel D455）1用于头部感知2腕部相机（Intel D405）2用于腕部感知3激光雷达（MID-360S）1SLAM

capabilities.sdk: MozRobot SDK; VR teleoperation; Pi0.5 model adaptation (docs)
notes: The manual says the robot must not run in rain, snow or in the open air ('机器人不应在雨天、雪天或露天环境下运行').
The manual forbids hazardous work such as work at height and heavy carrying ('禁止将机器人用于危险作业，如高空作业、重型搬运').
Omnidirectional wheeled base; the legs are replaced by the mobile platform ('双足被轮式移动平台代替').

evidence.task: Household service, office assistance, education and care tasks (manual scope)
evidence.note: No construction or site use reported; the manual rules out heavy carrying.
